title: EarthMC Recruitment Addon
description: Client-side EarthMC recruiting assistant that alerts on newly registered player joins and provides copyable recruit/follow-up messages.
body: EarthMC Recruitment Addon helps town recruiters spot newly joined EarthMC players and quickly copy personalized recruitment messages into chat. It also supports configurable follow-up messages after Towny joins, global ad reminders, optional /showitem prompts, and settings for delays, cooldowns, sounds, and message templates.
